name: Duck 4
summary: Duck 3.1's brain in a body with every motor 10 times stronger, on cobblestones up to 4 cm
what_changed: One change from Duck 3.1: the body. Every motor has 10 times the force limit and 10 times the stiffness: hips and knees 40 (from 4), ankles 30 (from 3), neck 10 (from 1), toes 5 (from 0.5); stiffness 200 for hips, knees and ankles (from 20), 40 for the neck (from 4) and 50 for the toes (from 5). The world is the same as Duck 3.1's second run: stones from flat up to 4 cm, walking speeds 0.2 to 0.7 m/s.
why: Duck 3.1 still falls on about two thirds of 4 cm floors, and Francisco wanted to see what the duck is capable of with much stronger muscles.
starts_from: Duck 3.1's kept brain (duck_catalogue/duck_03_1/brain, exam 1206 in the stones_up_to_4cm world)
notes: Duck 3.1's brain falls 10 of 10 times on flat ground in this body before training: its small commands now kick hard. Exam scores compare directly with Duck 3.1's second run (same world, same exam).

world_settings.name: stones_up_to_4cm
world_settings.description: Cobblestones from flat up to 4 cm, walking speeds 0.2 to 0.7 m/s

body_settings.name: ten_times_stronger
body_settings.description: Every motor 10 times stronger: 10 times the force limit and 10 times the stiffness
body_settings.notes: Both numbers go up together: with the old stiffness a motor would only reach its new force limit far off its target, so a higher limit alone would barely change how hard the duck pushes. Checked stable on 2026-10-31 (no simulation warnings with random commands).
